name: Randon One Block
author: PsyCrow1976
tagline: Experimental AI-built NeoForge skyblock — random center block, finished FTB quest book, Equivox EMC
pitch: 100% AI-assisted modpack experiment on Minecraft 26.1.2 (1.0.5.1). The author does not hand-write mods or KubeJS — Grok Composer 2.5 fast implements features from descriptions. Core loop: mine one skyblock center block, get a random modpack block back (KubeJS, inspired by Chaos OneBlock). First finished FTB quest-book pass (~888 quests), Equivox EMC (ProjectE renamed), Uncrafting Table, and quest-gated mod pools. Known issue: Equivox Philosopher’s Stone world-transmutation crashes on NeoForge 26.1.2.76 until upstream rebuild (github.com/Yaskulsky/Equivox/issues/5). No fixed endgame — a sandbox to see how far AI can go on the latest Minecraft.

inspiration.name: Chaos OneBlock
inspiration.credit: Random one-block re-roll concept — shout-out to the Chaos OneBlock creator
